prompt: During rolling deploys, a large share of ref-change events are being dropped instead of delivered: dispatchers terminate the messages and a delivery backlog builds up whenever publishers and consumers are running slightly different versions. Delivery recovers only once every node is back on the same version. Find why cross-version traffic is being rejected and fix it. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: ref event decode version skew rollout
why were ref deliveries dropped during deploy
ref event Term dropped dispatcher backlog
producer consumer independent deploy payload fields
_subject: refevents: tolerate unknown fields in RefEvent decode (cross-version skew) (#1910)
